answer: Sealed ambient-PUF locus attestation: each identity binds to a hardware token containing an unclonable copper-trace PUF and sensors. A verifier sends a fresh nonce; the token signs it only with live site data—tundra wind spectrum, wharf tide vibration, local RF—matching its survey. PUF keys cannot be copied or replayed. Sybil cost: one tamper-resistant token and one surveyed physical site per identity, plus maintenance; a single device cannot mint N identities.
